item.title: Jack Hughes and Connor Brown lead the Devils past the Rangers, 6-3

item.title: Photos capture a mass homecoming exodus from Dhaka for Eid al-Fitr holiday
item.description: DHAKA, Bangladesh (AP) — Bangladesh's capital Dhaka hums with work and noise. Now, it is beginning to empty. Millions of internal migrants are preparing to return home for Eid al-Fitr, the festival marking the end of Ramadan.
